title: Hybrid QBR run-of-show — Silent Sync & Decision Ledger
content:
Purpose: This doc is a lightweight facilitator kit for hybrid QBRs (mix of on-site and remote attendees). Focus: drive decisions, reduce meeting time by moving facts into a short asynchronous prework ("silent sync"), and capture clear 30/60/90 commitments in a Decision Ledger.

High-level flow (45–60 min meeting):
- Prework (silent sync, asynchronous, required) — completed 2 business days before the QBR
  - Customer CS contact fills a 5-min preflight form (top 3 wins, top 3 risks, renewal horizon, pressing asks). Link to form: CONFLUENCE-6543/preflight-form
  - Customer product/ops sends 10-slide highlight deck (5 slides max preferred) + 3 anonymized success metrics.
  - Admin: CS rep uploads last 30-day usage spikes, SLO misses, and one-sentence escalation rationale if present.

- Live QBR run-of-show (facilitator timings):
  1) 0:00–0:05 — Welcome, objective, success criteria for today (Facilitator)
     - Script opener: "Thanks all — quick purpose: align on renewal signal and 3 actions to remove friction in the next 30 days. We’ll skip long demos — we assume prework covered usage and ops data. If anything missing, flag now and we’ll add to the ledger."
  2) 0:05–0:15 — Customer highlights + top ask (Customer exec, 3min + 7min Q&A)
     - Facilitator prompt: "Can you say which of the three asks is most time-sensitive and why?"
  3) 0:15–0:25 — Health & signal review (CS rep)
     - Present a one-slide health heatmap (adoption, performance, ROI signals, support load)
     - Quick read: green/amber/red with a one-line rationale for each quadrant
  4) 0:25–0:40 — Decision lane: prioritize up to 3 items from the silent sync for action today
     - Use decision ledger rows (Decision, Owner, Due date, Success metric, Escalation lane)
     - Live vote: thumbs up/down/abstain (remote: poll)
  5) 0:40–0:50 — Commitments & risks (CS + Customer)
     - Capture owners, confirm next touchpoint, note blockers and runbooks
  6) 0:50–0:60 — Optional: technical deep-dive breakout or wrap and close (facilitator)

Facilitation cheat-sheet (phrases and fallbacks):
- If discussion stalls: "We have two options — table this and capture as backlog, or timebox to 6 minutes and agree a follow-up owner. Which do you prefer?"
- If stakeholders disagree on priority: run a quick rank-choice poll; if no majority, escalate to sponsor offline within 48 hours.
- If new risk emerges mid-meeting: capture it in "Risk — Triage" and assign a 48-hour owner to validate severity (CS triage).

Silent Sync (detailed prework instructions):
- Who completes: Customer primary exec + Product lead + CS rep
- Deliverables (all uploaded to the meeting folder):
  - One-slide success snapshot (metrics, target vs actual)
  - One-paragraph top-3 asks and ideal outcomes (customer authored)
  - 30-day usage CSV (or dashboard link) highlighting anomalies
  - One-line escalation note if there are open incidents
- CS rep checklist for validation: ensure files present, flag missing items to facilitator 48 hours before meeting

Decision Ledger template (copy into meeting doc; one row per discrete decision):
- Decision ID: DL-YYYYMMDD-01
- Title: Clear short phrase
- Description: One sentence context
- Owner: Person responsible for execution (name + email)
- Due date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Success metric: How we’ll know it’s done (1–2 short metrics)
- Risk level: low | medium | high
- Escalation: who to contact if blocked (name + channel)
- Status after meeting: committed | queued | deferred

Example ledger row (text):
- DL-20251002-01 | Upgrade inference endpoint to 8-bit quantized variant to reduce cost | Owner: Arjun Rao | Due: 2025-10-30 | Success metric: 20% reduction in per-token cost in staging | Risk: medium | Escalation: Eng-Infra-SRE Slack #infra-escalations | Status: committed

Renewal Readiness quick rubric (score 0–10):
- Product usage (0–3): 0 none, 1 sporadic, 2 steady, 3 expanding
- Ops stability (0–2): 0 frequent incidents, 1 occasional, 2 stable
- Business alignment (0–3): 0 low exec interest, 1 tactical, 2 strategic/expansion, 3 pipeline tied to renewal
- Advocate strength (0–2): 0 none, 1 single champion, 2 multiple champions
- Total = sum (0–10). Suggested next-step mapping: 8–10: proactive expansion plan; 5–7: targeted remediation + executive outreach; 0–4: restoration plan & weekly checkpoints.

Post-QBR 30/60/90 plan (templated milestones):
- 0–30 days: implement 1–2 committed ledger items, hold status sync at 2 weeks, escalate showstopper within 48h
- 31–60 days: demonstrate initial metric change (success metric), schedule a brief exec update
- 61–90 days: decision checkpoint — renewal dialogue / commercial adjustments if needed

Preflight facilitator checklist (to run 48–72 hours before):
- Confirm silent sync items present and accessible
- Confirm host has poll enabled and breakout rooms ready (Zoom or Meet)
- Confirm decision ledger document created and shared with attendee edit rights
- Confirm executive sponsor time is locked
- Confirm SRE/tech on-call availability if a tech deep-dive is requested

Meeting artifacts & ownership after the QBR:
- Decision Ledger (living doc) — owner: CS rep (update weekly)
- Action tracker (spreadsheet) — owner: Customer success operations (CS Ops)
- Quarterly executive summary (one-pager) — owner: Account Lead (send within 3 business days)

Signals to surface as immediate red flags (call for emergency play):
- Renewal visibility < 90 days AND usage trend negative 30d
- Severity > P3 incident unresolved > 72 hours and impacts production inference latency
- Multiple execs escalate to Legal/Compliance about data locality or KMS requirements

Housekeeping: Usages, links and ticket references should live in the shared folder and be referenced by ID (e.g., JIRA-CS-771). For templates and prework forms see: CONFLUENCE-6543 (preflight form) and /shared/qbr/templates (folder).

Notes / open questions (work-in-progress):
- Consider a short customer-facing 5-slide template that enforces the silent sync constraints (to reduce live demos).
- Explore embedding a 1-click poll in calendar invite to collect availability for 30/60/90 checkpoints.

Quick version history:
- 2025-09-18: initial sketch (Maya)
- 2025-09-24: added Decision Ledger sample (Ethan)
- 2025-10-02: tuned timings + added post-QBR 30/60/90 milestones (Sofia)

End of doc.
